title: Tuning snare and bass drums
summary: Happy explains what sharp and flat snare drums mean, tuning by ear, tuning the bass drum to G, and tom-toms.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used
